gst.note: GST 2.0 reform rationalized slabs into 0% (exempt), 5% (merit/essentials), 18% (standard), and 40% (luxury/sin). 12% and 28% remain supported as legacy slabs for past invoices.

ppf.note: PPF interest rate announced quarterly by Ministry of Finance. Rate is for Q2 FY2026-27; check official notification before display.

rd.note: RD rates vary by bank. Default is illustrative only. Users should enter their bank's actual rate.
